physics: MuJoCo 3.2.7, reference gait, CPU OSMesa rendering
sensor_observations: actual RGB and depth frames; noisy simulated 23-beam lidar; gyro; simulated foot/tibia tactile + relative FK
policy_pose: estimated from gyro/foot odometry and scan alignment; truth used only by simulator sensor drivers and error audit
caveats: Three short test scenes cannot establish SLAM accuracy or statistically robust navigation improvement
Scan matching improves one trajectory but worsens another; average is nearly tied to foot-only odometry
RGB recognition requires identical artificially cyan painted box targets
Planar ranger uses simulator geometry to emulate noisy idealized beams; not a rendered depth-based full 3D lidar
Body-relative foot positions and stance proxy are generated by simulation; physically calibrated sensors are not integrated
No ORB/optical flow, visual odometry, loop closure, real RGB detection, hardware force/torque safety, or real-robot transfer
The previous learned object action policy remains optional, locomotion uses validated V5 reference gait
